gloss: overthinking; imagining too much; needless worry

definitions.gloss: overthinking; imagining too much; groundless worry
definitions.explanation: The act of worrying about or reading too much into something that turns out to be nothing. Used to reassure someone (or oneself) that their concerns are unfounded.

examples.japanese: ⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧{思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I'm sure you're just overthinking it.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{過|す}ごし⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: It might just be my imagination, but his attitude bothers me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嫌|きら}われている→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}していた→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだった。
examples.english: I was worried that they hated me, but it was just my overthinking.

notes:
From ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) + ⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to do excessively). Describes the common experience of worrying about something that turns out to be unfounded. Very useful in everyday conversation for reassuring others or dismissing one's own anxieties.

USAGE:
Most commonly used as a predicate: {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだ / {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧. Also appears with ⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧ when the speaker is unsure: {思|おも}い{過|す}ごし⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧... (It might just be my imagination, but...).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{思|おも}い{過|す}ごし — just overthinking
- {思|おも}い{過|す}ごし⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧ — it might just be my imagination
- {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧ — I hope it's just my overthinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}のせい→気のせい：19893_kinosei⟧ — one's imagination; very similar, slightly more casual
- ⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧すぎ — overthinking; more direct, focuses on excessive analysis
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ — needless worry; implies worrying about the future unnecessarily
